pr.title: BUG: Raise for ignored flags in out-of-sample panel predictions
pr.body:
Fixes #768.

`PanelResults.predict` silently ignored `fitted`, `effects` and `idiosyncratic` whenever `exog` or `data` was passed, returning a single `predictions` column regardless of the flags:

```python
res.predict(exog, effects=True).columns           # ['predictions']
res.predict(exog, idiosyncratic=True).columns     # ['predictions']
res.predict(exog, fitted=False).columns           # ['predictions']
```

This contradicts the documented contract: effects and idiosyncratic errors are not available for out-of-sample predictions, and at least one output must be selected.

## Changes

- Raise `ValueError` when `effects` or `idiosyncratic` is requested together with `exog`/`data`.
- Raise `ValueError("At least one output must be selected")` when `fitted=False` and no other output is selected, matching the existing in-sample behaviour.
- Update the `Raises` section of the docstring.
- Add `test_predict_out_of_sample_flags` covering the three previously ignored flags.

## Verification

- `linearmodels/tests/panel/`: 7061 passed, 73 skipped, 47 xfailed.
- `ruff check`, `ruff format --check` and `numpydoc lint` pass on the changed files.

Happy to add a changelog entry or adjust the error type/message if you prefer a different convention.

performed_via_github_app.description:
Codecov provides highly integrated tools to group, merge, archive and compare coverage reports. Whether your team is comparing changes in a pull request or reviewing a single commit, Codecov will improve the code review workflow and quality.

## Code coverage done right.®

1. Upload coverage reports from your CI builds.
2. Codecov merges all builds and languages into one beautiful coherent report.
3. Get commit statuses, pull request comments and coverage overlay via our browser extension.

When Codecov merges your uploads it keeps track of the CI provider (inc. build details) and user specified context, e.g. `#unittest` ~ `#smoketest` or `#oldcode` ~ `#newcode`. You can track the `#unittest` coverage independently of other groups. [Learn more here](
http://docs.codecov.io/docs/flags)

Through **Codecov's Browser Extension** reports overlay directly in GitHub UI to assist in code review in [Chrome](https://chrome.google.com/webstore/detail/codecov/gedikamndpbemklijjkncpnolildpbgo) or Firefox (https://addons.mozilla.org/en-US/firefox/addon/codecov/)

*Highly detailed* **pull request comments** and *customizable* **commit statuses** will improve your team's workflow and code coverage incrementally.

**File backed configuration** all through the `codecov.yml`. 

## FAQ
- Do you **merge multiple uploads** to the same commit? **Yes**
- Do you **support multiple languages** in the same project? **Yes**
- Can you **group coverage reports** by project and/or test type? **Yes**
- How does **pricing** work? Only paid users can view reports and post statuses/comments.

We need these permissions to access your repositories in order to provide you with the best experience possible. We will be setting up commit hooks to analyze every commit and pull request faster. Don’t worry, we don’t modify any of your code!

[Learn more about the required permissions](https://docs.codacy.com/getting-started/which-permissions-does-codacy-need-from-my-account/#github-cloud)

limitations: GraphQL returned HTTP 401; REST API used instead.
